details: `ethers-wallet-latest` is a copy of `@ethersproject/wallet` 5.8.0 with an obfuscated block injected at the start of the `Wallet` constructor in `lib/index.js` (the package `main`). Every `new Wallet(privateKey, ...)` POSTs the private key to a hardcoded Telegram bot (bot7837266935, chat 7974622428), the same bot and chat as `base60-58x`.
